lw.label: Laubach-Williams
lw.how: Unobserved-components model of output, inflation and the real rate, one-sided estimate

hlw.label: Holston-Laubach-Williams
hlw.how: The same model with fewer inputs and a treatment of the pandemic

lm.label: Lubik-Matthes
lm.how: Time-varying vector autoregression: the real rate expected five years ahead

tips.label: TIPS 5y5y forward, raw
tips.how: Real yield for years 6 to 10: twice the 10-year minus the 5-year inflation-protected yield
tips.note: Includes the real term premium and the liquidity premium. Not in the median

dkw.label: Expected real short rate, years 6 to 10
dkw.how: The forward real rate less the real term premium and the liquidity premium, from an affine model of nominal and real yields
dkw.source: Federal Reserve Board (DKW), carried forward with the yield decomposition on this site

acm.label: Expected nominal path less expected inflation, years 6 to 10
acm.how: The expected nominal short rate from the ACM model minus expected inflation from the DKW model
acm.source: New York Fed (ACM), Federal Reserve Board (DKW)

dkw5.label: Expected real short rate, next 5 years
dkw5.how: The 5-year real yield less term and liquidity premia
dkw5.note: Includes the current cycle. Not in the median

dkw10.label: Expected real short rate, next 10 years
dkw10.how: The 10-year real yield less term and liquidity premia
dkw10.note: Includes the current cycle. Not in the median

sep.label: FOMC longer-run federal funds rate
sep.how: Median longer-run federal funds rate in the Summary of Economic Projections minus longer-run inflation

sme.label: Market participants, longer-run federal funds rate
sme.how: Median longer-run federal funds rate of dealers and investors minus their longer-run inflation
sme.source: New York Fed Survey of Market Expectations

spf.label: Professional forecasters, 10-year Treasury bill
spf.how: Median 10-year average 3-month bill rate minus median 10-year average inflation

cbo.label: CBO long-run projection
cbo.how: Federal funds rate minus inflation in the last projected year (2036)

trend.label: Trend of the 1-year ex-ante real rate
trend.how: One-sided Hodrick-Prescott trend of the 1-year Treasury yield minus expected inflation one year ahead
trend.note: Follows the cycle of policy, so it lags turning points

tips5hp.label: Trend of the 5-year TIPS yield
tips5hp.how: One-sided Hodrick-Prescott trend of the 5-year inflation-protected yield
tips5hp.note: Includes term and liquidity premia. Not in the median

rob_lw.label: Low-frequency neutral rate, Laubach-Williams gap
rob_lw.how: The real rate that would close the output gap each quarter in a stylised IS curve, then smoothed (Roberts 2018)
rob_lw.source: Federal Reserve Board (DKW), New York Fed output gap

rob_hlw.label: Low-frequency neutral rate, Holston-Laubach-Williams gap
rob_hlw.how: The real rate that would close the output gap each quarter in a stylised IS curve, then smoothed (Roberts 2018)
rob_hlw.source: Federal Reserve Board (DKW), New York Fed output gap

bcb.intro: The Banco Central do Brasil does not publish one neutral rate. In a box of its Inflation Report (June 2023, updated June 2024) it reports a set of measures and summarises them by their median. This section applies the same set to the United States.

rows.bcb: Policy rate expected in the Focus survey four years ahead, deflated by expected inflation at the same horizon
rows.us: Forecasters' 10-year Treasury bill rate less 10-year inflation

rows.bcb: The one-year ex-ante real rate from Focus, Hodrick-Prescott trend
rows.us: 1-year Treasury yield less expected inflation, Hodrick-Prescott trend

rows.bcb: High- and low-frequency neutral rates from a stylised IS curve (Roberts 2018), gap persistence 0.84 and rate sensitivity 0.75, with several output gaps
rows.us: The same equation and parameters on the expected 5-year real rate, with the two New York Fed output gaps

rows.bcb: Inflation-linked bond yields (NTN-B) at 5, 10 and 5-to-10 years, less a term premium
rows.us: TIPS yields at 5, 10 and 5-to-10 years, less term and liquidity premia

rows.bcb: Neutral rate filtered by the small semi-structural model: IS curve, Phillips curve, policy rule
Natural rate from the DSGE model (Samba), expected two and five years ahead
rows.us: The New York Fed publishes a DSGE estimate in its forecast notes, with no data file

rows.bcb: Analysts' own estimates in the questionnaire sent before each policy meeting
rows.us: Longer-run federal funds rate in the New York Fed survey of dealers and investors, less longer-run inflation

rows.bcb: Interest parity: a US real rate plus Brazil's sovereign risk plus the currency risk premium
rows.us: Does not apply: the US is the reference economy and carries neither premium. The three US rates the BCB feeds into this block are on this page: the 1-year real rate trend, the 5-year TIPS trend and Laubach-Williams

bcb.note: For Brazil the same exercise gave a median of 5.0% and an interquartile range of 4.7% to 5.5% in the June 2024 box.
